messages:
ana: Hey — nightly eval (2026-03-19 04:00 UTC) flagged a big uptick in generation variance for rdx-small-q4 on prompt set 'customer_support_100'. :eyes:
ci-bot: nightly-eval: rdx-small-q4 | coverage=100% | p99_latency=120ms | avg_token_variance:+18% | quality_drop: 12% (regression)
mike: Hmm, variance up 18% and quality drop 12%? did the model binary change or just the sampling config?
sophia: I pulled the eval diff — samples look noisier, more hallucinations and truncation. Attaching a few examples in thread.
nana: (typo) sorry, meant ana
ana: actually ana — none of the model hashes changed, build tag is the same: rdx-small-q4@2026-03-15-rc3
raj: Could be sampling params. Any chance top_p/top_k/temp got overwritten in the eval runner?
leila: I grep'd the nightly job logs: the runner loads sampling config from /etc/rdx/eval_sampling.json. Last edit was 2026-03-18 23:54 by deploy-bot.
ci-bot: git-ops: commit 4b7c9e update(eval): remove default sampling override — author deploy-bot
mike: Aha — previous nightly had an override that forced top_p=0.92,temp=0.7. If that was removed, the system falls back to model default which is temp=1.0,top_p=1.0. That would explain higher entropy.
nana: can you paste the runner config snippet?
sophia: snippet from the runner at 2026-03-19 03:59 UTC:
```
{
  "sampling": {
    "top_k": 40,
    "top_p": 1.0,
    "temperature": 1.0,
    "seed": null
  }
}
```
mike: compared to the previous enforced config (from deploy-bot commit):
```
{"sampling": {"top_k": 40, "top_p": 0.92, "temperature": 0.7, "seed": 42}}
```
raj: That seems like the smoking gun — bumping temp and top_p to 1.0 increases diversity and fragility. Also seed=null -> nondeterministic runs, so nightly metrics will be noisier.
leila: Why did deploy-bot remove the override? it was supposed to be preserved for eval consistency.
nana: pinging infra-config-team — @mike can you open a revert? I can patch the runner to reapply the enforced sampling for next nightly.
mike: On it, creating PR to reintroduce eval-sampling override with explicit seed=42 and top_p=0.92,temp=0.7.
ci-bot: pr: #1825 reintroduce eval sampling override — mike (open)
sophia: For immediate triage, can we re-run the nightly with the forced params to confirm regression is sampling-only?
leila: I queued a rerun job with the old override (seed=42) — job id 9983. ETA ~8m.
nana: great. If the rerun matches baseline, then we mark as sampling-config regression and update release notes.
raj: Also add a test in the nightly harness that asserts sampling config immutability unless explicitly bumped in gitops. Prevents accidental deploy-bot changes.
mike: Agreed. I'll add an assertion and a simple end-to-end that compares a small sample set with seed fixed.
sophia: Rerun finished: job 9983 — avg_token_variance:+1.2% | quality_drop: 0.8% (within noise). Looks like sampling change caused the spike. :thumbsup:
nana: Closing loop then. Root cause: gitops change removed eval sampling override (seed + conservative temp/top_p), causing nondeterministic, higher-entropy runs.
leila: Filing a postmortem note and tagging deploy-bot owner. Also adding a guard in deploy-bot to not remove eval overrides.
ci-bot: incident-tracker: created ticket #INC-4672 (sampling-config-regression)
mike: Thanks all. Follow-ups: PR to reintroduce override, unit test in nightly harness, and a watcher alert if sampling params in runner differ from canonical eval config.
sophia: I'll write the quickbench comparing temp variations to quantify sensitivity and add to runbook.
nana: nice. Closing thread once PR merges. :white_check_mark:
